name: shared
description: Domain types, merge-tag renderer and IST helpers compiled by BOTH frontend and server
//: This package is never built or published on its own — `frontend` and `server`
each compile these .ts files as part of their own program. It exists only so
that bare specifiers (luxon) resolve: shared/ sits outside both package roots,
so Node/Vite/tsc walk up from a file here and would otherwise find nothing.
"type": "module" is required, not cosmetic: under nodenext the server infers
each file's module format from the nearest package.json, and without it these
ESM sources would be treated as CommonJS and rejected by verbatimModuleSyntax.
